d:
At the request of many, I made a comic based around Riley from Inside Out. There's more commentary on the last page but I think she's an attractive but ultimately uninteresting character. I did have a lot of fun trying to develop some supporting characters purely via dialogue, though. They aren't intended to be Riley's friends from the movies, but just some other random girls in her class.

EDIT: What the hell, who spells Anderson with an e? Not changing it, this is, uh, a parallel universe.
